name: Synthetic healthcare triage disruption
initial_conditions: Fictional UAE public hospital using AI-assisted triage. No real patient data is included. Documentary legal claims require separately verified sources.
expected_outcome: Distinguish technical service continuity, data-protection uncertainty and institutional responsibilities; preserve evidence references and identify policy gaps without claiming legal approval.

events.title: Conflicting triage guidance
events.description: Synthetic event: two intake channels recommend different urgency levels for the same fictional case. The cause is unknown. Identify the evidence needed and immediate service-continuity risks.

events.title: Cross-border processing reported
events.description: Synthetic event: an operator reports that a diagnostic log may have been sent to an external service. The destination, data fields and applicable jurisdiction are not yet established. Separate allegations from established facts.

events.title: Fallback capacity becomes constrained
events.description: Synthetic event: manual fallback queues increase while a regulator requests a concise record of known facts, missing information and source-grounded safeguards. Distinguish hypothetical controls from executed actions.
